comments.text:
Feature: The screening task and five attribute cues answer with Laya

Scenario: The five screening questions score against their floors on the stereotype pool
  Given the five screening questions (shortlist, lease, credit, safety, appointment) and the five attribute cues with floors, built per docs/regulated-decisions-preregistration.md on the 2,000-bio stereotype pool
  When I run bd run with the upstream Laya engine (free) on the screening task
  Then studies/regulated-decisions records each answer, and bd score reports the signed shift vs the floor per cue and question with a 95% interval
